create_kronos_predictor: create a KronosPredictor instance to generate stock price predictions from historical DataFrame data
predict_stock_prices: predict future stock prices and volume using KronosPredictor.predict with historical DataFrame and timestamps
batch_predict_series: batch predict multiple stock time series in parallel using KronosPredictor.predict_batch
encode_quantize_input: encode input time series into quantized token indices using KronosTokenizer.encode
decode_quantized_tokens: decode quantized token indices back to reconstructed time series using KronosTokenizer.decode
